tasks.label: Run Jekyll Server

linux.command: podman run --rm -it --net=host --volume="${workspaceFolder}:/srv/jekyll:Z" docker.io/library/ruby:3.3 bash -c "cd /srv/jekyll && gem install bundler && bundle install && bundle exec jekyll serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4000"

tasks.detail: Runs the Jekyll server based on your OS.

tasks.label: Build Jekyll Site

linux.command: podman run --rm -it --volume="${workspaceFolder}:/srv/jekyll:Z" docker.io/library/ruby:3.3 bash -c "cd /srv/jekyll && gem install bundler && bundle install && bundle exec jekyll build"

tasks.detail: Build the Jekyll site for production based on your OS.
